trial_seed_rule: start_seed + zero_based_trial_index, matching the existing original-suite harness
implementation: Call unchanged generate_instance for random/boundary and compile_plan/generate_query_aware for query_aware. Execute and compare through unchanged engine.execute and compare.compare_results, with frozen guards and limits.
recording: Persist full rows, typed observations, statuses, errors, both-empty indicator, seed, schedule/statistics where supplied, effective pools, per-stage time, every planned trial including post-first-witness trials.
errors: Retain schema, planning, generation, runtime-guard, SQL and comparison failures as inconclusive. Do not edit the frozen cohort or tune generators. A plan failure only blocks query_aware, not baseline strategies.
replay: Independently validate every instance against its raw frozen single-table nullable-INTEGER schema. Replay every mismatch trial through the frozen standard-library SQLite checker in original and reverse insertion order; require mismatch both times and bag agreement with product observations. Record whether the data contain distinct rows so nontrivial reversals are separated from vacuous ones.
controls: A mismatch on an intended control is a contradiction requiring independent replay and upstream-source inspection; retain and report it rather than removing the task.
analysis: Report 27 known-different and 28 intended-control denominators separately; per-task/repeat and per-cluster counts; paired gains/losses across the same tasks/seeds; all errors/both-empty/time. No superiority or population-recall claim from this three-cluster source-informed cohort.
immutability: A new output directory and a new execution manifest are required. This reproduces the frozen design without overwriting the recorded run.
